decisions.reason: The platform is the flagship. It sits at the core of the firm's GIS and enterprise integration knowledge and is supported by its own R&D, so the firm is well placed to interpret results and keep improving it.

Mobile field data capture is close to the firm's established geospatial competence and fits its integrated solution offering, so management can absorb customer feedback and refine it rather than drop it.

The search extension builds directly on the firm's web map app ecosystem and was being actively versioned in 2019, which shows ongoing learning and development, although small plugins like A–C have been pruned before.
